description: walrus-fmt export restructure + real backends + MSRV gate (design.md sections 7, 9; plan.md Part A). Make `pub mod export` UNGATED with an always-compiled metadata surface (ExportFormat incl. an Original variant, ExportUnavailable, offered_formats, to_original), split export.rs into export/{mod,original,html,markdown,csv,json,pdf,docx}.rs with only heavy backends feature-gated, add the export crate deps at EXACT versions behind the existing export-* features, and gate MSRV through the workspace rust-version. Breaking signature change: to_markdown/to_html/to_json/to_csv/to_pdf/to_docx all return crate::Result<Vec<u8>>; to_html/to_pdf/to_docx take mime: &str; to_csv is net-new. This feature is INDEPENDENT of FEAT-002 and must land first because FEAT-002's walker export UI consumes offered_formats/ExportFormat/to_*. walrus-fmt stays GUI-free; prove the dependency boundary. Grep confirmed NO existing caller of export::to_* outside export.rs, so the breaking change touches no production call site.
steps: In crates/walrus/src/lib.rs remove the #[cfg(any(feature = "export-*"))] attribute so `pub mod export;` is UNGATED.

Convert crates/walrus/src/export.rs into a directory module crates/walrus/src/export/mod.rs holding the ALWAYS-compiled surface: ExportFormat (keep #[non_exhaustive]; add an `Original` variant), ExportUnavailable, offered_formats, and re-exports of the backend fns under their cfgs. Move stub bodies to their own files (next steps).

TDD offered_formats + to_original FIRST: write failing tests in export/mod.rs #[cfg(test)] that MUST compile and pass with NO export feature -- offered_formats("text/csv") includes Csv, a prose mime (text/plain) OMITS Csv, Original and PlainText always present, markdown/plain sources add Markdown. Then implement offered_formats(mime: &str) -> Vec<ExportFormat> (pure data, ungated) in export/mod.rs and to_original(doc: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> (verbatim passthrough, ungated) in export/original.rs.

In crates/walrus/Cargo.toml add optional deps at EXACT versions: pulldown-cmark = "0.11", scraper = "0.20", csv = "1.3", genpdf = "0.2", docx-rs = "0.4" (all optional = true). Wire features: export-html = ["dep:pulldown-cmark", "dep:scraper"], export-md = ["dep:pulldown-cmark"], export-csv = ["dep:csv"], export-json = [] (serde_json already non-optional), export-pdf = ["dep:genpdf"], export-docx = ["dep:docx-rs"], export-all = all six.

MSRV gate (design 7.3): after adding deps, run `cargo +1.95.0 build -p walrus-fmt --features export-all` if a 1.95 toolchain exists, else build on the local 1.98.1 and record that caveat. If ANY export crate requires > 1.95, raise the WORKSPACE rust-version in [workspace.package] to the lowest satisfying value, add a comment naming the forcing crate on that line, and record it in ROADMAP.md -- no per-package override. If genpdf 0.2 fails to resolve or forces MSRV past ~1.80, switch PDF to printpdf = "0.7". Keep docx-rs regardless; document its MSRV if it forces a bump; never hand-roll OOXML. If a crate's real MSRV conflicts with design assumptions, call send_message with severity warning before diverging.

TDD + implement to_csv (net-new, cfg export-csv) in export/csv.rs: write a failing round-trip test (CSV in -> same rows out, ragged rows preserved) then implement to_csv(doc: &[u8]) -> crate::Result<Vec<u8>> using the csv crate; return Err on parse failure, never panic. Add any new WalrusError variant needed in error.rs.

TDD + implement the breaking-signature text backends: to_html(doc, mime: &str) -> crate::Result<Vec<u8>> (cfg export-html) in export/html.rs -- output has <!doctype html>, balanced wrapper, HTML-escapes < > &; when mime is text/markdown render via pulldown-cmark to the safe subset (no scripts, no remote fetch); use scraper for HTML text extraction. to_markdown(doc) -> crate::Result<Vec<u8>> (cfg export-md) in export/markdown.rs -- passthrough for markdown, fenced block for other text. to_json(doc) -> crate::Result<Vec<u8>> (cfg export-json) in export/json.rs -- wrap text in a JSON object via serde_json pretty, forgiving on non-JSON input. Write the failing assertions first for each.

TDD + implement the heavy binary backends: to_pdf(doc, mime: &str) -> crate::Result<Vec<u8>> (cfg export-pdf) in export/pdf.rs -- extract text (scraper for HTML, else lossy UTF-8), lay out with genpdf (or printpdf if swapped), output non-empty and starts with %PDF-. to_docx(doc, mime: &str) -> crate::Result<Vec<u8>> (cfg export-docx) in export/docx.rs -- build a .docx via docx-rs, output is a zip whose directory contains word/document.xml and [Content_Types].xml. Build fully in memory; never panic; write the failing assertions first.
Ensure export/mod.rs re-exports every backend under its cfg; confirm no split file exceeds 400 non-test lines and all are strict ASCII.
acceptance_criteria: `cargo build -p walrus-fmt` (no features) compiles the always-present ExportFormat/ExportUnavailable/offered_formats/to_original surface.
`cargo tree -p walrus-fmt` (no features) lists NONE of pulldown-cmark, scraper, csv, genpdf, docx-rs (dependency boundary proof).
`cargo test -p walrus-fmt` (no features) passes the offered_formats/to_original boundary tests.

`cargo build -p walrus-fmt --features export-all` compiles on the pinned MSRV (or local toolchain with the caveat recorded); any required MSRV bump raises only the workspace rust-version and names the forcing crate in Cargo.toml + ROADMAP.md.

`cargo test -p walrus-fmt --features export-all` passes: to_html well-formed + escaped, to_markdown fenced-block shape, to_csv round-trip, to_json valid JSON, to_pdf starts with %PDF-, to_docx is a zip containing word/document.xml, to_original byte-identical.
`cargo clippy -p walrus-fmt --all-features -- -D warnings` is clean; no .rs file exceeds 400 non-test lines; strict ASCII; no unwrap/expect in library code.
